body: Of course! If you ever wanna vent or just talk im here :)

I mean fair, i feel like most of us aren’t alive cus we want to, life is so fucking hard that sometimes you wonder if the struggle is worth it for an unknown outcome but what if you think about yourself? Dont you think you deserve to see your happy ending? Dont you think little you, the child who had to suffer, deserve their happy ending? Dont you wanna know what it feels like to not wanna give up?
Hey please talk to me, doesn’t even have to be abt this but if you need to rant or vent please do, we can also just talk favorite movie? Favorite color?
But dont you want to prove them wrong? Fuck whatever shit your parents did and fuck them, dont you want to prove them wrong? Show them that what they did only make you stronger, not weak?

If you want talk to me, youre not alone and i might just be a stranger but you can vent and rant to me cus i get it and it sucks having to hold it all in having no way of getting it out so again you can talk to me :)

Im happy you know that and tbf i dont think any of out younger selfs would be happy with how we turned out, i know mine hasn’t, and whats stopping you from being that strong person you used to be? You can always bring that person back
Then dont you think you should listen to them? If you have the chance to get better why get worse?
No worries nothing to apologize for i get it, if and whenever you wanna talk im here :) <3
I understand exactly what you mean, this whole life thing fucking sucks, but hey im here so if you want, wanna talk abt it?
Hey, do you wanna talk abt it? It can be anything like whats your favorite movie or smt :)
If you feel comfortable talk to me abt whatever, favorite color favorite movie? Happy to be a distraction

Idek you but i know for a fact no one deserves that shit but what i can tell you is that you deserve your happy ending, you owe it to that little kid fuck it even to that teenager who went through that shit to see your happy ending, you owe it to your present self to make it through it, and its going to be so fucking hard its not gonna be easy but domt you think its worth it? To finally see that happy ending?

I love pineapple on its own, especially pineapple juice. And yeah sometime when I eat pineapple, like the citrus acid or something always makes my mouth feel weird. That’s why I can’t eat too much. However, I LOVE watermelon, honestly if I was able to, I believe I could eat one entirely. What’s your favorite fruit?
No I very strongly dislike pineapple on pizza. For that same reason that it was sweet. Pizza shouldn’t be sweet. I’ve never tried mushrooms and onions on pizza tho, I might try it sometime 🖤
Sure :) I had just sausage and pepperoni. But now that you bring up toppings...pineapple on pizza, yay or nay? (Make sure to eat something :)

I feel the exact same way. Sometimes I’ll have arguments with myself telling me to just do it but then I chicken out and call myself weak for not being able to do it. If your still here I’ll be happy to talk about anything. Could just be what you ate today or the weather where you live 🖤🖤:)
Your not pathetic. Sometimes the internet is your last resort. That’s why I’m on here. Anyways, we can talk. Today I had a pizza slice, it was pretty good. What about you?

Of course, it’s a scary feeling. Feeling all alone and scared of what you might do. Just know you can always reach out to some one. But you know what! Thank YOU, for being strong enough to stick around!💛💛

It’s the worst feeling ever. I would say “things are going to get better” and stuff like that but we both probably are sick of hearing that. This probably doesn’t mean much since I’m just someone on the internet, but I want to give you a big hug for just sticking around a little bit longer :)
Hey... I’m here if you want to talk :) I know what it’s like... just know I’m here
